requirements.title: A whole-map write is denied to any stream that is not the root client
requirements.text: Server.WriteEP0 shall return ErrNotRootClient when called by a stream that has not claimed the root-client role via Server.ClaimRoot.

requirements.title: A restricted stream can read and write an endpoint explicitly granted to it
requirements.text: Server.ReadEndpoint and Server.WriteFunctional shall succeed for a non-root stream when that endpoint's address has been granted to it via Server.Grant.

requirements.title: A restricted stream is denied access to an endpoint that was never granted to it
requirements.text: Server.ReadEndpoint and Server.WriteFunctional shall return ErrAccessDenied for a non-root stream addressing an endpoint it was never granted via Server.Grant.

requirements.title: The root-client role is exclusive to one stream at a time
requirements.text: AccessController.ClaimRoot shall return ErrRootAlreadyClaimed when a stream other than the current root client attempts to claim the role, and shall succeed idempotently when the current root client re-claims it.

requirements.title: GeneralBlock round-trips all fields through Encode/DecodeGeneralBlock
requirements.text: EncodeGeneralBlock followed by DecodeGeneralBlock shall reproduce an identical GeneralBlock: identification fields, register-map version, capability/capacity counters, and the four configuration-table pointers shall all survive the round-trip byte-for-byte.

requirements.title: PinMap.Validate rejects a named-signal index out of range for its endpoint's declared type
requirements.text: PinMap.Validate shall return ErrPinMapInvalid when an assignment's SignalIndex is not a valid index into SignalName for its Endpoint's declared EndpointType.

requirements.title: Register-map decoders never panic on arbitrary input, and golden vectors freeze the whole-map encoding
requirements.text: DecodeGeneralBlock and DecodeRegisterMap shall return an error or a valid value for any arbitrary byte slice and shall never panic or slice out of bounds, as verified by fuzz testing; in addition, a fixed golden byte-vector fixture shall pin the exact whole-register-map encoding EncodeRegisterMap produces for a representative configuration so later milestones can regression-test against a frozen register-map format.

requirements.title: ReadDiscovery answers in every lifecycle state and regardless of access grants
requirements.text: Server.ReadDiscovery shall return the whole encoded register map for a calling stream regardless of the server's current LifecycleState (StateUnconfigured, StateHWLocked, or StateFullyConfigured) and regardless of whether that stream is the root client or holds any AccessController grant for EP0.

requirements.title: Discovery reads remain available to other streams while one stream holds the configuration claim
requirements.text: Server.ReadDiscovery shall continue to succeed for any calling stream even while a different stream holds an active Discovery-stream configuration claim (Server.ClaimConfiguration); the configuration claim shall never block a concurrent discovery read.

requirements.title: HandleDiscoveryRequest rejects a timestamped (TSCF) discovery request
requirements.text: Server.HandleDiscoveryRequest shall return ErrDiscoveryRequiresUntimedHeader, and no register-map bytes, when given an avtp.Header with Timed set to true.

requirements.title: HandleDiscoveryRequest answers an untimed (NTSCF) discovery request
requirements.text: Server.HandleDiscoveryRequest shall return the same bytes as Server.ReadDiscovery, with no error, when given an avtp.Header with Timed set to false.

requirements.title: ClaimConfiguration reserves configuration rights for the first stream and denies a different stream
requirements.text: Server.ClaimConfiguration shall succeed for the first stream to call it, and shall return ErrConfigurationClaimed when a different stream calls it while that reservation remains unexpired.

requirements.title: ClaimConfiguration is idempotent and renews the timeout for the claim-holding stream
requirements.text: Server.ClaimConfiguration shall succeed when called again by the stream that already holds the active configuration claim, and shall extend the claim's expiry by a full configuration-claim-timeout window measured from that call.

requirements.title: An expired configuration claim can be reclaimed by a different stream
requirements.text: Server.ClaimConfiguration shall succeed for a different stream once the current claim holder's configuration-claim-timeout has elapsed with no follow-up configuration request, and Server.ConfigurationClaimant shall report no active claimant once the timeout has elapsed and before any stream reclaims it.

requirements.title: ReleaseConfigurationClaim releases the holder's claim early and rejects a non-holder
requirements.text: Server.ReleaseConfigurationClaim shall clear an active configuration claim when called by its current holder, and shall return ErrNotConfigurationClaimant when called by any stream that is not the current active claim holder.

requirements.title: IsConformantServer recognizes a genuine server's identification, version, and vendor/product fields
requirements.text: IsConformantServer shall return true for a GeneralBlock whose RegisterMapVersion matches this package's supported RegisterMapVersion and whose VendorID and ProductID are both nonzero, and shall return false if any of those conditions does not hold.

requirements.title: DiscoverTopology and WriteTopology/ReadTopology round-trip a discovered server's persisted topology
requirements.text: DiscoverTopology shall extract a Topology whose VendorID, ProductID, RegisterMapVersion, and per-endpoint Address/Type entries match the source RegisterMap; WriteTopology followed by ReadTopology shall reproduce an equal Topology value.

requirements.title: Config.Validate enforces pin-count and active-pin-mask bounds
requirements.text: gpio.Config.Validate shall return ErrPinCountOutOfRange when PinCount is zero or exceeds MaxPins, or when Direction or TriggerEnable sets any bit outside the active-pin mask ((1<<PinCount)-1).

requirements.title: WriteSemantic.Valid recognizes exactly the eight defined semantics
requirements.text: gpio.WriteSemantic.Valid shall return true for exactly the eight defined write-semantic values (SemanticReplace through SemanticReconfigure) and false for any other value.

requirements.title: Combining semantics affect only output-direction pins
requirements.text: gpio.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall apply SemanticReplace/Or/And/AndNot/Xor to only the output-direction pins (Config.Direction bits set), leaving every input-direction pin's value unchanged.

requirements.title: Saturating semantics clamp instead of wrapping
requirements.text: gpio.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall clamp SemanticSaturatingAdd at the endpoint's active-pin mask and SemanticSaturatingSubtract at zero, rather than wrapping on overflow/underflow.

requirements.title: Reconfigure replaces Direction and persists the change
requirements.text: gpio.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall, for SemanticReconfigure, replace Config.Direction with the request operand masked to the endpoint's active pins, persist the change through server.Server.WriteFunctional, and leave the pin value unchanged.

requirements.title: HandleRequest routes Read/Write and rejects neither
requirements.text: gpio.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall return the endpoint's current pin value for a request with FlagRead set, the resulting pin value for a request with FlagWrite set, and ErrRequestMustReadOrWrite for a request with neither flag set.

requirements.title: HandleRequest rejects the wrong endpoint or an ungranted stream
requirements.text: gpio.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall return ErrWrongEndpoint when a request's ByteBusID does not match the endpoint's own address, and shall return the underlying server.ErrAccessDenied when the requesting stream has no access grant for the endpoint.

requirements.title: Triggers queue only for TriggerEnable pins
requirements.text: gpio.Endpoint shall queue a TriggerEvent only when a pin whose Config.TriggerEnable bit is set changes value, and shall not queue an event for a change confined to non-trigger pins.

requirements.title: SetInputs only drives input-direction pins
requirements.text: gpio.Endpoint.SetInputs shall drive only the endpoint's input-direction pins from its mask argument, leaving every output-direction pin's value unchanged, and shall queue trigger events for input-pin changes the same way a write does.

requirements.title: DrainTriggers returns events FIFO and clears the queue
requirements.text: gpio.Endpoint.DrainTriggers shall return every queued TriggerEvent in the order it was recorded, clear the queue, and return nil when no events are pending.

requirements.title: GPIO encoders/decoders round-trip and never panic
requirements.text: gpio.EncodeConfig/DecodeConfig and gpio.EncodeWriteRequest/DecodeWriteRequest/DecodeValue shall round-trip their respective structures and shall return ErrShortBuffer or ErrTrailingBytes rather than panicking on a malformed buffer.

requirements.title: GPIO golden vectors pin the frozen wire byte layout
requirements.text: gpio.EncodeConfig and gpio.EncodeWriteRequest/EncodeValue shall produce the exact frozen byte sequences pinned by this package's golden-vector tests for a fixed representative input.

requirements.title: Channel.Valid recognizes exactly the six defined channels
requirements.text: spi.Channel.Valid shall return true for exactly Channel0 through Channel5 (MaxChannels) and false for any other value.

requirements.title: SetChannelConfig isolates one channel's configuration
requirements.text: spi.Endpoint.SetChannelConfig shall persist the given ChannelConfig for exactly the selected channel through server.Server.WriteFunctional, leaving every other channel's configuration in the persisted register map unchanged.

requirements.title: Mode.Valid recognizes exactly the four defined clock modes
requirements.text: spi.Mode.Valid shall return true for exactly Mode0 through Mode3 and false for any other value.

requirements.title: HandleRequest dispatches by sub-opcode and rejects an unconfigured channel
requirements.text: spi.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall dispatch a transfer request to the chip-select channel named by its sub-opcode byte, and shall return ErrChannelNotConfigured when that channel's ChannelConfig.Enabled is false.

requirements.title: HandleRequest requires Write, the right endpoint, and access
requirements.text: spi.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall return ErrRequestMustWrite when a request does not set FlagWrite, ErrWrongEndpoint when its ByteBusID does not match the endpoint's own address, and the underlying server.ErrAccessDenied when the requesting stream has no access grant.

requirements.title: A configured Transport performs the transfer, defaulting to loopback
requirements.text: spi.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall perform a channel's transfer through its configured Transport when one is set via SetTransport, and shall default to a loopback echo of the transmitted bytes when none is set.

requirements.title: Every transfer queues a transfer-complete trigger with its byte count
requirements.text: spi.Endpoint shall queue a TriggerTransferComplete event carrying the number of bytes received for every completed transfer.

requirements.title: Chip-select-edge triggers bracket each transfer in order
requirements.text: spi.Endpoint shall queue a TriggerChipSelectEdge asserted event immediately before, and a deasserted event immediately after, each transfer's byte exchange, and spi.Endpoint.DrainTriggers shall return all queued events in that recorded order.

requirements.title: Config.Validate rejects an implausible channel and round-trips all slots
requirements.text: spi.Config.Validate shall return ErrZeroClock or ErrInvalidMode for any enabled channel with a zero clock rate or an unrecognized Mode, and spi.EncodeConfig/DecodeConfig shall round-trip all MaxChannels channel slots including disabled ones.

requirements.title: SPI decoders never panic on malformed input
requirements.text: spi.DecodeConfig and spi.DecodeTransferRequest shall return ErrShortBuffer, ErrTrailingBytes, or ErrInvalidChannel rather than panicking on a malformed buffer.

requirements.title: SPI golden vectors pin the frozen wire byte layout
requirements.text: spi.EncodeConfig and spi.EncodeTransferRequest shall produce the exact frozen byte sequences pinned by this package's golden-vector tests for a fixed representative input.

requirements.title: Config.Validate enforces bus speed validity when enabled
requirements.text: i2c.Config.Validate shall return nil for a disabled bus regardless of Speed, and shall return ErrInvalidSpeed for an enabled bus whose Speed is not one of this package's five recognized values.

requirements.title: BusSpeed.Valid recognizes exactly the five defined speed classes
requirements.text: i2c.BusSpeed.Valid shall return true for exactly SpeedStandard through SpeedUltraFast and false for any other value; this package's numbering is its own reasoned resolution of an ambiguous/colliding bus-speed enumeration in the source behavioral description, flagged as an open item pending confirmation against a public interoperability reference.

requirements.title: I2C Config encoders/decoders round-trip and never panic
requirements.text: i2c.EncodeConfig/DecodeConfig shall round-trip a Config value and shall return ErrShortBuffer or ErrTrailingBytes rather than panicking on a malformed buffer.

requirements.title: HandleRequest requires Write, the right endpoint, and access
requirements.text: i2c.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall return ErrRequestMustWrite when a request does not set FlagWrite, ErrWrongEndpoint when its ByteBusID does not match the endpoint's own address, and the underlying server.ErrAccessDenied when the requesting stream has no access grant.

requirements.title: HandleRequest rejects a transfer against a disabled bus
requirements.text: i2c.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall return ErrBusNotConfigured when a transfer request is handled against an endpoint whose Config.Enabled is false.

requirements.title: A configured Transport performs the transfer, defaulting to loopback
requirements.text: i2c.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall perform a transfer through its configured Transport when one is set via SetTransport, and shall default to a loopback echo of the transmitted bytes when none is set.

requirements.title: Every transfer queues a transaction-complete trigger with its byte count
requirements.text: i2c.Endpoint shall queue a TriggerEvent carrying the number of bytes received for every completed transfer, and Endpoint.DrainTriggers shall return queued events in FIFO order and clear the queue.

requirements.title: I2C decoders never panic on malformed input
requirements.text: i2c.DecodeConfig and i2c.DecodeTransferRequest shall never panic on arbitrary input, including empty and truncated buffers.

requirements.title: I2C golden vectors pin the frozen wire byte layout
requirements.text: i2c.EncodeConfig and i2c.EncodeTransferRequest shall produce the exact frozen byte sequences pinned by this package's golden-vector tests for a fixed representative input.

requirements.title: Config.Validate enforces baud rate, data bits, parity, and stop bits when enabled
requirements.text: uart.Config.Validate shall return nil for a disabled endpoint regardless of its other fields, and for an enabled endpoint shall return ErrZeroBaudRate, ErrInvalidDataBits, ErrInvalidParity, or ErrInvalidStopBits as appropriate for an implausible field.

requirements.title: Parity.Valid and StopBits.Valid recognize exactly their defined values
requirements.text: uart.Parity.Valid shall return true for exactly ParityNone through ParitySpace and false otherwise; uart.StopBits.Valid shall return true for exactly StopBitsOne through StopBitsTwo and false otherwise.

requirements.title: UART Config encoders/decoders round-trip and never panic
requirements.text: uart.EncodeConfig/DecodeConfig shall round-trip a Config value and shall return ErrShortBuffer or ErrTrailingBytes rather than panicking on a malformed buffer.

requirements.title: HandleRequest routes Write to TX and Read to RX, rejecting neither flag or a non-payload-less read
requirements.text: uart.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall dispatch a request with FlagWrite set to TX and a request with FlagRead set to RX, shall return ErrRequestMustReadOrWrite for a request with neither flag set, and shall return ErrReadRequestNotPayloadLess for a read request carrying a nonempty body.

requirements.title: HandleRequest rejects the wrong endpoint, an ungranted stream, or a disabled endpoint
requirements.text: uart.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall return ErrWrongEndpoint when a request's ByteBusID does not match the endpoint's own address, the underlying server.ErrAccessDenied when the requesting stream has no access grant, and ErrUARTNotConfigured when the endpoint's Config.Enabled is false.

requirements.title: TX uses the configured Transport, defaults to TX-to-RX loopback, and queues a TX-complete trigger
requirements.text: uart.Endpoint shall transmit through its configured Transport when one is set via SetTransport, shall default to looping transmitted bytes directly into its own RX FIFO when none is set, and shall queue a TriggerTXComplete event carrying the accepted byte count for every TX write.

requirements.title: RX read drains the FIFO up to the requested count and reports partial delivery on underfill
requirements.text: uart.Endpoint's RX read handling shall drain up to the request's ReadSizeOrSegment bytes from the RX FIFO, reporting complete=false and returning fewer bytes when the FIFO cannot fill the full request, and complete=true once the full requested count is available.

requirements.title: Receive appends to the RX FIFO and queues an RX-data-available trigger
requirements.text: uart.Endpoint.Receive shall append its argument to the RX FIFO and queue a TriggerRXDataAvailable event carrying the newly arrived byte count, and Endpoint.DrainTriggers shall return queued events in FIFO order and clear the queue.

requirements.title: UART decoders never panic on malformed input
requirements.text: uart.DecodeConfig, uart.DecodeReadResponse, and uart.DecodeWriteResponse shall never panic on arbitrary input, including empty and truncated buffers.

requirements.title: UART golden vectors pin the frozen wire byte layout
requirements.text: uart.EncodeConfig and uart.EncodeReadResponse shall produce the exact frozen byte sequences pinned by this package's golden-vector tests for a fixed representative input.

requirements.title: Config.Validate enforces resolution, sample count, and enum bounds when enabled
requirements.text: adc.Config.Validate shall return nil for a disabled channel regardless of its other fields, and for an enabled channel shall return ErrInvalidResolution, ErrInvalidSampleCount, ErrInvalidCombineMode, or ErrInvalidTriggerMode as appropriate for an implausible field.

requirements.title: CombineMode.Valid and TriggerMode.Valid recognize exactly their defined values
requirements.text: adc.CombineMode.Valid shall return true for exactly CombineReplace and CombineRollingAverage and false otherwise; adc.TriggerMode.Valid shall return true for exactly TriggerModeOnDemand through TriggerModeSelf and false otherwise.

requirements.title: ADC Config encoders/decoders round-trip and never panic
requirements.text: adc.EncodeConfig/DecodeConfig shall round-trip a Config value and shall return ErrShortBuffer or ErrTrailingBytes rather than panicking on a malformed buffer.

requirements.title: Trigger samples, averages, and combines, masked to the configured resolution
requirements.text: adc.Endpoint.Trigger shall take Config.SampleCount raw readings from the configured Transport, arithmetic-average them, combine the average with the endpoint's previous value under Config.Combine, mask the result to Config.ResolutionBits, and queue a TriggerMeasurementDone event carrying that value.

requirements.title: Trigger rejects a disabled channel and defaults to an always-zero sample source
requirements.text: adc.Endpoint.Trigger shall return ErrChannelNotConfigured when Config.Enabled is false, and shall treat every raw sample as zero when no Transport is set via SetTransport.

requirements.title: HandleRequest routes Read/Write, rejecting neither flag, the wrong endpoint, or an ungranted stream
requirements.text: adc.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall perform a manual trigger for a request with FlagWrite set, shall return ErrRequestMustReadOrWrite for a request with neither flag set, ErrWrongEndpoint when its ByteBusID does not match the endpoint's own address, and the underlying server.ErrAccessDenied when the requesting stream has no access grant.

requirements.title: A plain read samples fresh under TriggerModeOnDemand and returns the cached value otherwise
requirements.text: adc.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall perform a fresh Trigger for a read request when Config.TriggerMode is TriggerModeOnDemand, and shall instead return the endpoint's latest already-measured value without sampling when TriggerMode is TriggerModeExternal or TriggerModeSelf.

requirements.title: DrainTriggers returns queued measurement-done events FIFO and clears the queue
requirements.text: adc.Endpoint.DrainTriggers shall return every queued TriggerEvent in the order it was recorded, clear the queue, and return nil when no events are pending.

requirements.title: ADC decoders never panic on malformed input
requirements.text: adc.DecodeConfig and adc.DecodeValue shall never panic on arbitrary input, including empty and truncated buffers.

requirements.title: ADC golden vectors pin the frozen wire byte layout
requirements.text: adc.EncodeConfig and adc.EncodeValue shall produce the exact frozen byte sequences pinned by this package's golden-vector tests for a fixed representative input.

requirements.title: Config.Validate enforces role and the default output waveform's active/period invariant
requirements.text: pwm.Config.Validate shall return nil for a disabled endpoint regardless of its other fields, ErrInvalidRole for an enabled endpoint whose Role is not recognized, and ErrActiveExceedsPeriod for an enabled RoleOutput endpoint whose DefaultActiveMicros exceeds DefaultPeriodMicros.

requirements.title: Role.Valid recognizes exactly the two defined roles
requirements.text: pwm.Role.Valid shall return true for exactly RoleOutput and RoleInput and false for any other value.

requirements.title: PWM Config and waveform encoders/decoders round-trip and never panic
requirements.text: pwm.EncodeConfig/DecodeConfig and pwm.EncodeWaveform/DecodeWaveform shall round-trip their respective structures and shall return ErrShortBuffer or ErrTrailingBytes rather than panicking on a malformed buffer.

requirements.title: HandleRequest routes Read/Write, rejecting neither flag, the wrong endpoint, an ungranted stream, or a disabled endpoint
requirements.text: pwm.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall return ErrRequestMustReadOrWrite for a request with neither FlagRead nor FlagWrite set, ErrWrongEndpoint when its ByteBusID does not match the endpoint's own address, the underlying server.ErrAccessDenied when the requesting stream has no access grant, and ErrNotConfigured when the endpoint's Config.Enabled is false.

requirements.title: A write request is only accepted for a RoleOutput endpoint and rejects an implausible waveform
requirements.text: pwm.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall return ErrWriteNotSupportedForInput for a write request against a RoleInput endpoint, and shall return ErrActiveExceedsPeriod for a write request whose ActiveMicros exceeds its PeriodMicros.

requirements.title: Configure applies a RoleOutput endpoint's default waveform, and writes go through the configured OutputTransport
requirements.text: pwm.Endpoint.Configure shall immediately apply a RoleOutput Config's default waveform exactly as a write request would, and Endpoint.HandleRequest shall apply subsequent write requests through the configured OutputTransport when one is set via SetOutputTransport, defaulting to storing the waveform for readback when none is set.

requirements.title: A RoleInput read returns the captured waveform and fails explicitly on signal loss
requirements.text: pwm.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall return the most recently captured waveform for a read request against a RoleInput endpoint, through the configured InputTransport when one is set via SetInputTransport or via SetCapturedWaveform/SetSignalLost otherwise, and shall return ErrSignalLost rather than stale data when no valid waveform has been captured or signal loss was most recently reported.

requirements.title: DrainTriggers returns queued output/capture/signal-loss events FIFO and clears the queue
requirements.text: pwm.Endpoint.DrainTriggers shall return every queued TriggerEvent in the order it was recorded, clear the queue, and return nil when no events are pending.

requirements.title: PWM decoders never panic on malformed input
requirements.text: pwm.DecodeConfig and pwm.DecodeWaveform shall never panic on arbitrary input, including empty and truncated buffers.

requirements.title: PWM golden vectors pin the frozen wire byte layout
requirements.text: pwm.EncodeConfig and pwm.EncodeWaveform shall produce the exact frozen byte sequences pinned by this package's golden-vector tests for a fixed representative input.

requirements.title: Kind.Valid and IsCancellation recognize exactly the defined values
requirements.text: request.Kind.Valid shall return true for exactly the eight non-plain Kind constants (KindCompound through KindCancelSequencer) and false for KindPlain and any value at or beyond the sentinel; request.Kind.IsCancellation shall return true for exactly KindCancelAll, KindCancelTransaction, and KindCancelSequencer.

requirements.title: Kind.Priority implements the fixed cross-type execution-priority ordering
requirements.text: request.Kind.Priority shall rank the three cancellation variants equally and ahead of every other Kind, followed in order by KindChained, KindTriggered, KindTimed, KindCompoundWait, KindCompound, and KindPlain last.

requirements.title: CompareOp.Evaluate and Valid implement the six comparison operators
requirements.text: request.CompareOp.Evaluate shall correctly implement equal/not-equal/less/less-or-equal/greater/greater-or-equal for its six defined values, and CompareOp.Valid shall return false for any value at or beyond the sentinel.

requirements.title: Sequencer registers wrap on Advance and only advance on a matched Conditional
requirements.text: request.Sequencer.Advance shall add its delta modulo 2^32 (wrapping rather than saturating), each SequencerID shall address an independent register starting at zero, and evaluating a Conditional shall advance its register only when the comparison holds.

requirements.title: Compound/CompoundWait envelopes round-trip through Encode/Decode
requirements.text: request.EncodeCompound/DecodeCompound and EncodeCompoundWait/DecodeCompoundWait shall round-trip a Conditional and (for Compound) an inner Control/Body, PeekKind shall report the leading Kind byte without consuming the rest of the buffer, and each decoder shall reject a short buffer, trailing bytes, or a mismatched Kind tag.

requirements.title: Triggered/Timed envelopes round-trip through Encode/Decode
requirements.text: request.EncodeTriggered/DecodeTriggered and EncodeTimed/DecodeTimed shall round-trip their trigger source or target execution time alongside an inner Control/Body.

requirements.title: Cancellation envelopes and responses round-trip through Encode/Decode
requirements.text: request.EncodeCancelAll/DecodeCancelAll, EncodeCancelTransaction/DecodeCancelTransaction, and EncodeCancelSequencer/DecodeCancelSequencer shall round-trip their scope, and EncodeConditionalResponse/DecodeConditionalResponse and EncodeCancelResponse/DecodeCancelResponse shall round-trip their result payloads.

requirements.title: Chained request envelopes round-trip through Encode/Decode
requirements.text: request.EncodeChained/DecodeChained shall round-trip an ordered list of ChainedSegment values, reject zero segments, and reject a truncated buffer.

requirements.title: Chained response bodies preserve fail-fast abort information
requirements.text: request.EncodeChainedResponse/DecodeChainedResponse shall round-trip a partial ChainedResult, preserving which segment (if any) is marked Failed and the original Total segment count even when fewer segments actually ran.

requirements.title: request package decoders never panic on malformed input
requirements.text: Every DecodeXxx function in the request package shall never panic on arbitrary input, including empty and truncated buffers.

requirements.title: Dispatcher retrofits KindPlain requests onto the wrapped Handler unchanged
requirements.text: request.Dispatcher shall dispatch a Message without avtp.FlagExtended set directly to its wrapped Handler with the same Control/Body semantics a Phase 14 endpoint's own HandleRequest already implements, and the resulting response shall not carry avtp.FlagExtended.

requirements.title: Dispatcher gates KindCompound execution and sequencer advance on a match
requirements.text: request.Dispatcher shall call the wrapped Handler for a KindCompound ticket only when its Conditional matches, shall advance the addressed sequencer register only on a match, and shall report ConditionalResult.Matched and the resulting sequencer value in the response regardless of outcome.

requirements.title: Dispatcher never calls the wrapped Handler for KindCompoundWait
requirements.text: request.Dispatcher shall evaluate a KindCompoundWait ticket's Conditional and report its outcome without ever calling the wrapped Handler, regardless of whether the condition matches.

requirements.title: Dispatcher defers KindTriggered execution until its TriggerPump reports an event
requirements.text: request.Dispatcher.Pump shall leave a KindTriggered ticket pending until its registered TriggerPump for the referenced source reports at least one new event, shall call each distinct source's TriggerPump at most once per Pump call, and shall consume at most one reported event per satisfied ticket.

requirements.title: Dispatcher defers KindTimed execution until the caller-supplied clock reaches its target
requirements.text: request.Dispatcher.Pump shall leave a KindTimed ticket pending until called with now at or past its encoded target execution time.

requirements.title: Dispatcher executes KindChained segments strictly in order and aborts on failure
requirements.text: request.Dispatcher shall call the wrapped Handler once per ChainedSegment in declared order, and shall stop executing remaining segments (without skipping ahead) the moment one segment's Handler call returns an error, reporting ErrChainedSegmentFailed.

requirements.title: Cancellation kinds clear only their declared scope of pending tickets
requirements.text: request.Dispatcher shall have KindCancelAll finalize every other pending ticket, KindCancelTransaction finalize only the pending ticket matching its TransactionNum, and KindCancelSequencer finalize only pending KindCompound/KindCompoundWait tickets gated on its SequencerID, each reporting ErrTicketCancelled and leaving every non-matching pending ticket untouched.

requirements.title: Dispatcher.Submit enforces the configured AccessCheck before any decoding
requirements.text: request.Dispatcher.Submit shall reject a request with the AccessCheck's error, for every Kind including KindCompoundWait and every cancellation variant, when a non-nil AccessCheck rejects the requester.

requirements.title: Dispatcher.Pump applies the fixed cross-type priority ordering within one call
requirements.text: request.Dispatcher.Pump shall execute every ticket that becomes ready within one call in Kind.Priority order (lower rank first), regardless of submission order, when more than one ticket on the same Dispatcher becomes eligible simultaneously.

requirements.title: Dispatcher ticket bookkeeping (Response/StateOf/Forget/Pending) behaves correctly
requirements.text: request.Dispatcher.Response shall report ErrUnknownTicket for an unissued or Forgotten TicketID and ErrPending for a ticket not yet StateFinalized; Forget shall discard only a finalized ticket's bookkeeping and be a no-op otherwise; Pending shall count only tickets not yet StateFinalized.

requirements.title: request package golden vectors pin the frozen conditional-request wire byte layout
requirements.text: request.EncodeCompound and EncodeCancelAll shall produce the exact frozen byte sequences pinned by this package's golden-vector tests for a fixed representative input, and dispatching a golden KindCompound envelope end-to-end against a real endpoint shall produce the expected wrapped response.

requirements.title: Kind safety-request tagging (IsSafety/Base/Valid/Priority) is correct
requirements.text: request.Kind.IsSafety and Kind.Base shall round-trip losslessly for KindCompoundSafety/KindCompoundWaitSafety/KindTriggeredSafety against their respective base Kind; Kind.Valid shall accept exactly those three safety-tagged values and reject KindSafetyFlag applied to any other base Kind; Kind.Priority shall rank a safety-request Kind identically to its Base kind.

requirements.title: Safety-request envelope encoders share their base kind's Decode function
requirements.text: request.EncodeCompoundSafety, EncodeCompoundWaitSafety, and EncodeTriggeredSafety shall produce envelopes with an identical body layout to their base-kind Encode counterpart differing only in the leading Kind byte, decodable by the same DecodeCompound/DecodeCompoundWait/DecodeTriggered function as the base kind, with PeekKind reporting the safety-tagged Kind value.

requirements.title: Dispatcher gates safety-request Kinds on a configured SafeStateCheck
requirements.text: request.Dispatcher.Submit shall reject a safety-request Kind with ErrSafeStateNotConfigured when no SafeStateCheck is configured, and Dispatcher.Pump shall leave a safety-request ticket in StateStarted on every call for which SetSafeStateCheck's configured function reports false for that ticket's requester, advancing it only once that function reports true.

requirements.title: Dispatcher.PurgeNonSafety clears only non-safety pending tickets
requirements.text: request.Dispatcher.PurgeNonSafety shall finalize every not-yet-finalized ticket whose Kind is not a safety-request variant with ErrPurgedByWatchdog, and shall leave every safety-request ticket's state and pending status completely unchanged.

requirements.title: Compute covers stream addressing, message addressing/timestamp fields, and the whole message
requirements.text: e2e.Compute shall be deterministic for a given (stream, Message) pair, and shall produce a different CRC32 value when the stream, ByteBusID, TransactionNum, Control, ReadSizeOrSegment, Timestamp, or Body of its input changes.

requirements.title: Protect/Verify round-trip a message through a trailing CRC32 safe point
requirements.text: e2e.Protect shall append a Len-byte trailing CRC32 safe point to a Message's Body computed by Compute over the message as given, and e2e.Verify shall strip and validate that trailing field, returning a Message with Body restored to its original contents when the safe point is valid.

requirements.title: Verify rejects a short or mismatched safe point without exposing a usable message
requirements.text: e2e.Verify shall report ErrShortSafePoint when a message's Body is shorter than Len, and shall report ErrCRCMismatch without returning a usable inner message when the trailing CRC32 does not match the CRC recomputed over any covered field, including a tampered payload byte with an otherwise-intact trailing CRC.

requirements.title: ComputeFragmented matches Compute over an equivalent reassembled single message
requirements.text: e2e.ComputeFragmented, given a shared header and a slice of per-segment Body byte slices, shall produce exactly the CRC32 that e2e.Compute would produce for a single message carrying the same header with Body set to every segment's Body concatenated in order.

requirements.title: Guard skips the wrapped Handler on a CRC failure and re-Protects a successful response
requirements.text: e2e.Guard.HandleRequest shall not call its wrapped request.Handler and shall return ErrCRCMismatch when the inbound message's safe point fails Verify, and shall call the wrapped Handler with the Verify-recovered inner message and return that Handler's response re-Protected with a fresh safe point when the inbound safe point is valid.

requirements.title: Supervisor.Observe enforces configured sequence monotonicity and overflow wraparound
requirements.text: e2e.Supervisor.Observe shall report an error wrapping ErrSequenceViolation and sticky-trip that stream when StreamConfig.RequireMonotonicSequence is set and an arrival's sequence number does not strictly follow the previous one, shall accept a wraparound from the maximum uint32 value to zero when SequenceOverflowWraps is also set, and shall always rearm the stream's inter-arrival timeout clock regardless of whether a violation was recorded.

requirements.title: Supervisor.InSafeState reflects inter-arrival Timeout on its injectable clock
requirements.text: e2e.Supervisor.InSafeState shall report true for a stream Observe has never been called for, false immediately after a qualifying Observe call, and true again once the stream's configured Timeout has elapsed since its last Observe call, all measured against the Supervisor's injectable clock function.

requirements.title: Supervisor.CheckFunc matches InSafeState and Reset clears a sticky trip
requirements.text: e2e.Supervisor.CheckFunc's returned request.SafeStateCheck shall report exactly the same boolean InSafeState reports for the same stream at the same call, and Supervisor.Reset shall clear a stream's sticky monotonicity-violation trip and rearm its timeout clock from the moment Reset is called.

requirements.title: Supervisor-driven safe-state gating and watchdog purge integrate correctly with Dispatcher
requirements.text: Wiring a e2e.Supervisor's CheckFunc into a request.Dispatcher's SetSafeStateCheck, and calling Dispatcher.PurgeNonSafety once Supervisor.InSafeState reports true for a stream, shall finalize that Dispatcher's ordinary pending tickets for that stream with ErrPurgedByWatchdog while leaving a submitted safety-request ticket pending until InSafeState itself reports true, at which point that surviving ticket shall execute normally on the next Pump call.

requirements.title: Config.Validate enforces a nonzero baud rate when enabled
requirements.text: lin.Config.Validate shall return nil for a disabled bus regardless of BaudRate, and shall return ErrInvalidBaudRate for an enabled bus whose BaudRate is zero.

requirements.title: LIN Config encoder/decoder round-trips and never panics
requirements.text: lin.EncodeConfig/DecodeConfig shall round-trip a Config, and DecodeConfig shall return ErrShortBuffer or ErrTrailingBytes rather than panicking on a malformed buffer.

requirements.title: HandleRequest rejects a non-write request, the wrong endpoint, and an ungranted stream
requirements.text: lin.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall return ErrRequestMustWrite for a request without the Write control flag set, ErrWrongEndpoint when its ByteBusID does not match the endpoint's own address, and the underlying server.ErrAccessDenied when the requesting stream has no access grant.

requirements.title: HandleRequest rejects a transfer against a disabled bus
requirements.text: lin.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall return ErrBusNotConfigured for a transfer request handled against an endpoint whose Config.Enabled is false.

requirements.title: A transfer is performed through the configured Transport, defaulting to loopback
requirements.text: lin.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall perform a transfer request through the Transport configured via SetTransport when one is set, and shall default to echoing the transmitted bytes back (loopback) when none is set.

requirements.title: DrainTriggers returns queued transaction-complete events FIFO and clears the queue
requirements.text: lin.Endpoint.DrainTriggers shall return every queued TriggerEvent in the order it was recorded, clear the queue, and return nil when no events are pending.

requirements.title: LIN decoders never panic on malformed input
requirements.text: lin.DecodeConfig and lin.DecodeTransferRequest shall never panic on arbitrary input, including empty and truncated buffers.

requirements.title: LIN golden vectors pin the frozen wire byte layout
requirements.text: lin.EncodeConfig and lin.EncodeTransferRequest shall produce the exact frozen byte sequences pinned by this package's golden-vector tests for a fixed representative input.

requirements.title: Config.Validate enforces a nonzero nominal bitrate when enabled
requirements.text: can.Config.Validate shall return nil for a disabled bus regardless of its bitrate fields, and shall return ErrInvalidBitrate for an enabled bus whose NominalBitrateKbps is zero.

requirements.title: CAN Config encoder/decoder round-trips and never panics
requirements.text: can.EncodeConfig/DecodeConfig shall round-trip a Config, and DecodeConfig shall return ErrShortBuffer or ErrTrailingBytes rather than panicking on a malformed buffer.

requirements.title: Format.Valid recognizes exactly the three defined frame formats
requirements.text: can.Format.Valid shall return true for exactly FormatClassical, FormatFD, and FormatXL, and false for any other value.

requirements.title: Frame.Validate enforces per-format payload caps, ID width, and field applicability
requirements.text: can.Frame.Validate shall return ErrInvalidFormat for an unrecognized Format, ErrIDOutOfRange when ID exceeds its Extended/standard width, ErrPayloadTooLarge when Data exceeds Format's maximum payload length, ErrBitRateSwitchNotSupported for a FormatClassical frame with BitRateSwitch set, and ErrXLHeaderNotSupported for a non-FormatXL frame with a nonzero XLHeader.

requirements.title: CAN Frame encoder/decoder round-trips for every frame format and never panics
requirements.text: can.EncodeFrame/DecodeFrame shall round-trip a Frame for FormatClassical, FormatFD, and FormatXL (including XLHeader and up to XLMaxPayload bytes of Data), and DecodeFrame shall return ErrShortBuffer or ErrTrailingBytes rather than panicking on a malformed buffer.

requirements.title: HandleRequest rejects a request with neither flag, the wrong endpoint, and an ungranted stream
requirements.text: can.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall return ErrRequestMustReadOrWrite for a request with neither FlagRead nor FlagWrite set, ErrWrongEndpoint when its ByteBusID does not match the endpoint's own address, and the underlying server.ErrAccessDenied when the requesting stream has no access grant.

requirements.title: HandleRequest rejects a request against a disabled bus
requirements.text: can.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall return ErrNotConfigured for a request handled against an endpoint whose Config.Enabled is false.

requirements.title: A write request validates, echoes, and transmits through the configured Transport
requirements.text: can.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall reject a write request whose decoded Frame fails Validate before ever reaching Transport, shall echo an accepted Frame back in the response, and shall hand it to the Transport configured via SetTransport when one is set.

requirements.title: A read request returns the most recently received Frame or fails explicitly
requirements.text: can.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall return the Frame most recently recorded via SetReceivedFrame for a read request, and shall return ErrNoFrameReceived rather than a stale or zero-value Frame when none has been received yet.

requirements.title: CAN golden vectors pin the frozen wire byte layout
requirements.text: can.EncodeConfig and can.EncodeFrame shall produce the exact frozen byte sequences pinned by this package's golden-vector tests for a fixed representative input.

requirements.title: Config.Validate enforces a nonzero device count when enabled
requirements.text: iseled.Config.Validate shall return nil for a disabled chain regardless of DeviceCount, and shall return ErrInvalidDeviceCount for an enabled chain whose DeviceCount is zero.

requirements.title: ISELED Config encoder/decoder round-trips and never panics
requirements.text: iseled.EncodeConfig/DecodeConfig shall round-trip a Config, and DecodeConfig shall return ErrShortBuffer or ErrTrailingBytes rather than panicking on a malformed buffer.

requirements.title: Command encoder/decoder round-trips and detects a corrupted ISELED-native CRC
requirements.text: iseled.EncodeCommand/DecodeCommand shall round-trip a Command, DecodeCommand shall return ErrCRCMismatch when the trailing CRC8 does not match the one ComputeCRC recomputes over the decoded Address and Data, and shall return ErrShortBuffer or ErrTrailingBytes rather than panicking on a malformed buffer.

requirements.title: AggregatedResponse encoder/decoder round-trips for zero, one, and several device responses
requirements.text: iseled.EncodeAggregatedResponse/DecodeAggregatedResponse shall round-trip an AggregatedResponse of any length, and DecodeAggregatedResponse shall return ErrShortBuffer rather than panicking when the buffer does not contain enough bytes for its declared entry count.

requirements.title: HandleRequest rejects a non-write request, the wrong endpoint, and an ungranted stream
requirements.text: iseled.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall return ErrRequestMustWrite for a request without the Write control flag set, ErrWrongEndpoint when its ByteBusID does not match the endpoint's own address, and the underlying server.ErrAccessDenied when the requesting stream has no access grant.

requirements.title: HandleRequest rejects a command against a disabled chain or an out-of-range device address
requirements.text: iseled.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall return ErrChainNotConfigured for a command handled against an endpoint whose Config.Enabled is false, and ErrDeviceAddressOutOfRange for a targeted Command whose Address is not DeviceBroadcast and is not less than the configured DeviceCount.

requirements.title: A targeted command exchanges through the default loopback or the configured Transport, and queues a trigger
requirements.text: iseled.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall answer a targeted Command with a single-entry AggregatedResponse echoing its Data through the default loopback with no Transport configured, or through the Transport configured via SetTransport when one is set, and shall queue a TriggerEvent recording the response count on every exchange.

requirements.title: A DeviceBroadcast command's default loopback aggregates one response per configured device
requirements.text: iseled.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall answer a Command addressed to DeviceBroadcast with an AggregatedResponse containing one entry per device 0..Config.DeviceCount-1, each echoing the command's Data, when no Transport is configured.

requirements.title: ISELED golden vectors pin the frozen wire byte layout
requirements.text: iseled.EncodeConfig and iseled.EncodeCommand shall produce the exact frozen byte sequences pinned by this package's golden-vector tests for a fixed representative input.

requirements.title: MDIO Config encoder/decoder round-trips and never panics
requirements.text: mdio.EncodeConfig/DecodeConfig shall round-trip a Config, and DecodeConfig shall return ErrShortBuffer or ErrTrailingBytes rather than panicking on a malformed buffer.

requirements.title: AddressMode.Valid recognizes exactly the two defined address modes
requirements.text: mdio.AddressMode.Valid shall return true for exactly ModeClause22 and ModeClause45, and false for any other value.

requirements.title: Request.Validate enforces mode-dependent PHY/device/register address widths
requirements.text: mdio.Request.Validate shall return ErrInvalidAddressMode for an unrecognized Mode, ErrPhyAddrOutOfRange when PhyAddr exceeds its 5-bit width, ErrDevAddrNotSupported for a ModeClause22 Request with a nonzero DevAddr, ErrRegAddrOutOfRange for a ModeClause22 Request whose RegAddr exceeds its 5-bit width, and ErrDevAddrOutOfRange for a ModeClause45 Request whose DevAddr exceeds its 5-bit width.

requirements.title: MDIO read/write request and response encoders/decoders round-trip and never panic
requirements.text: mdio.EncodeReadRequest/DecodeReadRequest, mdio.EncodeWriteRequest/DecodeWriteRequest, and mdio.EncodeResponse/DecodeResponse shall each round-trip their respective structures, and shall return ErrShortBuffer or ErrTrailingBytes rather than panicking on a malformed buffer.

requirements.title: HandleRequest rejects a request with neither flag, the wrong endpoint, and an ungranted stream
requirements.text: mdio.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall return ErrRequestMustReadOrWrite for a request with neither FlagRead nor FlagWrite set, ErrWrongEndpoint when its ByteBusID does not match the endpoint's own address, and the underlying server.ErrAccessDenied when the requesting stream has no access grant.

requirements.title: HandleRequest rejects a request against a disabled endpoint or an addressing-invalid Request
requirements.text: mdio.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall return ErrNotConfigured for a request handled against an endpoint whose Config.Enabled is false, and shall return the Request.Validate error for a decoded Request that fails validation.

requirements.title: A register access is performed through the default in-memory store or the configured Transport, and queues a trigger
requirements.text: mdio.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall read/write through an in-memory per-(Mode,PhyAddr,DevAddr,RegAddr) register store (reading as zero until written) with no Transport configured, or through the Transport configured via SetTransport when one is set, and shall queue a TriggerEvent recording the access on every read and write.

requirements.title: MDIO golden vectors pin the frozen wire byte layout
requirements.text: mdio.EncodeConfig and mdio.EncodeReadRequest shall produce the exact frozen byte sequences pinned by this package's golden-vector tests for a fixed representative input.

requirements.title: Config.Validate enforces a nonzero wake-handshake interval and repeat count when enabled
requirements.text: wakeup.Config.Validate shall return nil for a disabled endpoint regardless of its other fields, ErrInvalidHandshakeInterval for an enabled endpoint whose WakeHandshakeIntervalMillis is zero, and ErrInvalidHandshakeRepeatCount for an enabled endpoint whose WakeHandshakeRepeatCount is zero.

requirements.title: Wakeup Config encoder/decoder round-trips and never panics
requirements.text: wakeup.EncodeConfig/DecodeConfig shall round-trip a Config, and DecodeConfig shall return ErrShortBuffer or ErrTrailingBytes rather than panicking on a malformed buffer.

requirements.title: PowerState.Valid and String cover exactly the four defined power states
requirements.text: wakeup.PowerState.Valid shall return true for exactly PowerNormal, PowerStandBy, PowerSleep, and PowerUnpowered and false for any other value, and PowerState.String/StartKind.String shall render a distinct, non-empty name for each of their defined values and "Unknown" for any other value.

requirements.title: PowerState request/response and WakeHandshake encoders/decoders round-trip and never panic
requirements.text: wakeup.EncodePowerStateRequest/DecodePowerStateRequest and wakeup.EncodeWakeHandshake/DecodeWakeHandshake shall each round-trip their respective structures, and shall return ErrShortBuffer or ErrTrailingBytes rather than panicking on a malformed buffer.

requirements.title: HandleRequest rejects a request with neither flag, the wrong endpoint, and an ungranted stream
requirements.text: wakeup.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall return ErrRequestMustReadOrWrite for a request with neither FlagRead nor FlagWrite set, ErrWrongEndpoint when its ByteBusID does not match the endpoint's own address, and the underlying server.ErrAccessDenied when the requesting stream has no access grant.

requirements.title: HandleRequest rejects a request against a disabled endpoint and a write targeting PowerUnpowered
requirements.text: wakeup.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall return ErrNotConfigured for a request handled against an endpoint whose Config.Enabled is false, and shall return ErrCannotRequestUnpowered without changing State for a write request targeting PowerUnpowered.

requirements.title: A write request transitions and echoes State, a read reports it, and a same-state write is an idempotent no-op
requirements.text: wakeup.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall apply a write request's target PowerState, echo it in the response, and reflect it in a subsequent Endpoint.State call, a read request shall report the current PowerState, and a write request targeting the state the endpoint is already in shall succeed as a no-op without queuing an additional TriggerPowerStateChanged event.

requirements.title: A Sleep-to-Normal wake determines StartKind, queues the configured wake-handshake repeats, and AcknowledgeWake discards the rest
requirements.text: wakeup.Endpoint.transitionTo shall determine Endpoint.LastStartKind as StartHot on a Sleep-to-Normal wake by default and StartCold when Endpoint.SetRetentionLost was called since the preceding Normal-to-Sleep transition, shall queue exactly Config.WakeHandshakeRepeatCount TriggerWakeHandshake events with sequentially increasing Sequence numbers on that wake, and Endpoint.AcknowledgeWake shall discard every not-yet-drained TriggerWakeHandshake event while leaving every other queued TriggerEvent untouched.

requirements.title: Wakeup golden vectors pin the frozen wire byte layout
requirements.text: wakeup.EncodeConfig and wakeup.EncodePowerStateRequest shall produce the exact frozen byte sequences pinned by this package's golden-vector tests for a fixed representative input.

requirements.title: Split leaves a small message unchanged and rejects invalid input
requirements.text: fragment.Split shall return the given Message unchanged as a single-element slice when its Body already fits within maxBody, shall return ErrInvalidMaxSegmentBody for a non-positive maxBody, ErrAlreadyFragmented when the Message already carries avtp.FlagMoreSegments, and ErrTooManySegments when the Body would require more non-terminal segments than the wire's 16-bit segment-number field can represent.

requirements.title: Split's segments carry correct sequencing and shared descriptor fields, and losslessly reconstruct the original Body
requirements.text: fragment.Split shall set avtp.FlagMoreSegments and a 0-based ReadSizeOrSegment segment number on every segment but the last, shall clear avtp.FlagMoreSegments and restore the original ReadSizeOrSegment value on the last segment, shall preserve Kind/ByteBusID/TransactionNum/Timestamp verbatim across every segment, and the ascending-order concatenation of every segment's Body shall equal the original Body.

requirements.title: Reassembler.Add treats an unfragmented message as an immediately complete sequence
requirements.text: fragment.Reassembler.Add shall report a Message with avtp.FlagMoreSegments clear, addressed to a Key with no prior buffered segments, as immediately complete, and fragment.Reassembler.Finish shall then return that Message's own Body and descriptor fields unchanged.

requirements.title: Reassembler.Add enforces strict in-order non-terminal segment numbering and tolerates exact-duplicate retransmissions
requirements.text: fragment.Reassembler.Add shall return ErrOutOfOrderSegment (abandoning the sequence) when a non-terminal segment's own segment number does not equal the sequence's next expected index, shall silently accept a byte-for-byte repeat of the most recently accepted segment or of an already-completed sequence's terminal segment as a no-op, and shall return ErrDuplicateSegment (abandoning the sequence) for a same-numbered segment whose Body differs from the one already buffered.

requirements.title: Reassembler.Add enforces shared descriptor-field consistency across one sequence's segments
requirements.text: fragment.Reassembler.Add shall return ErrHeaderMismatch, abandoning the sequence, when a later segment's Kind, Timestamp, or Control (apart from avtp.FlagMoreSegments) disagrees with the first segment already buffered for the same Key.

requirements.title: Reassembler.Add enforces Config.MaxSegments
requirements.text: fragment.Reassembler.Add shall return ErrTooManySegments, abandoning the sequence, when accepting a segment would cause an in-progress sequence's buffered segment count to exceed its configured Config.MaxSegments.

requirements.title: Reassembler.Finish returns the exact concatenation of accepted segments once complete
requirements.text: fragment.Reassembler.Finish shall return the ascending-order concatenation of every segment Body accepted for a completed sequence's Key together with that sequence's shared descriptor fields, shall return ErrIncomplete for a Key whose sequence has not yet received its terminal segment, and ErrUnknownSequence for a Key naming no sequence this Reassembler currently holds.

requirements.title: Sweep purges only stale, incomplete sequences
requirements.text: fragment.Reassembler.Sweep shall purge and report the Key of every incomplete sequence that has not accepted a new segment within the configured Config.Timeout, and shall never purge a sequence that has already received its terminal segment regardless of age.

requirements.title: FinishProtected verifies a fragmented message's CRC32 safe point via e2e.ComputeFragmented
requirements.text: fragment.Reassembler.FinishProtected shall recompute the trailing CRC32 safe point of a completed sequence's terminal segment via e2e.ComputeFragmented over the sequence's own per-segment Body slices, returning the reassembled Message with that field stripped on a match, wrapping e2e.ErrCRCMismatch on a mismatch, and returning e2e.ErrShortSafePoint when the terminal segment's Body is too short to contain one — matching what e2e.Verify computes for the same logical message sent unfragmented.

requirements.title: Gateway.Submit reassembles a fragmented request before admitting it to the wrapped request.Dispatcher
requirements.text: fragment.Gateway.Submit shall pass an unfragmented Message directly to the wrapped Submitter's Submit method, shall return ErrAwaitingSegments with no ticket admitted for a non-terminal segment of an in-progress sequence, and shall call Submit exactly once with the fully reassembled Message once a sequence's terminal segment arrives.

requirements.title: Gateway.Response splits a too-large resolved response
requirements.text: fragment.Gateway.Response shall return an unchanged single-element slice for a Message whose Body already fits within the configured MaxSegmentBody, and shall otherwise split it per fragment.Split's own segmenting rule.

requirements.title: Fragment golden vectors pin the frozen segment wire byte layout
requirements.text: fragment.Split, combined with avtp.EncodeMessage, shall produce the exact frozen byte sequences pinned by this package's golden-vector tests for a fixed representative multi-segment input, and decoding those frozen bytes back through fragment.Reassembler shall reconstruct the original Body.

requirements.title: Watch registers a (stream, Dispatcher) pair and deduplicates repeats
requirements.text: watchdog.Keeper.Watch shall register the given Dispatcher against the given stream so Streams reports that stream, and shall treat re-registering the identical (stream, Dispatcher) pair as a no-op rather than storing a duplicate entry.

requirements.title: Tick performs no purge for a stream whose watchdog has not tripped
requirements.text: watchdog.Keeper.Tick shall not call PurgeNonSafety on any Dispatcher registered under a stream for which the configured e2e.Supervisor's InSafeState currently reports false, and shall not include that stream in its returned PurgeEvent slice.

requirements.title: Tick purges non-safety tickets on every Dispatcher registered under a tripped stream
requirements.text: watchdog.Keeper.Tick shall call PurgeNonSafety on every Dispatcher registered against a stream for which the configured e2e.Supervisor's InSafeState currently reports true, leaving every safety-request ticket on that Dispatcher untouched and leaving every Dispatcher registered only against untripped streams untouched.

requirements.title: Tick reports a PurgeEvent even when a tripped stream's purge cleared nothing
requirements.text: watchdog.Keeper.Tick shall include one PurgeEvent per stream whose watchdog tripped during that call, with a nil Purged field when that stream's purge cleared zero tickets, so a caller can distinguish a tripped-but-empty purge from a stream that never tripped at all.

requirements.title: A Dispatcher shared by two streams is purged safely when both trip together
requirements.text: watchdog.Keeper.Tick shall, when a single Dispatcher is registered against two streams that both trip in the same Tick call, call that Dispatcher's PurgeNonSafety once per tripped stream without double-reporting any TicketID across the returned PurgeEvents and without erroring.

requirements.title: Pump relays every drained power-state-changed trigger as an Event
requirements.text: powerstate.Driver.Pump shall return one Event, carrying the newly-entered wakeup.PowerState, for every TriggerPowerStateChanged value drained from the wrapped wakeup.Endpoint during that call, in the order they were queued.

requirements.title: Pump paces wake-handshake retransmission to at most one send per call
requirements.text: powerstate.Driver.Pump shall queue every TriggerWakeHandshake value drained from the wrapped wakeup.Endpoint during that call, and shall invoke its configured Transmitter at most once per Pump call, in the order the repeats were queued.

requirements.title: A Transmitter failure leaves a wake-handshake repeat pending for retry
requirements.text: powerstate.Driver.Pump shall, when its configured Transmitter returns an error, leave the handshake it attempted to send at the front of this Driver's own pending queue for the next Pump call to retry, and shall return that error to its caller.

requirements.title: Acknowledge discards both drained-but-unsent and not-yet-drained repeats
requirements.text: powerstate.Driver.Acknowledge shall discard every wake-handshake repeat still queued on the wrapped wakeup.Endpoint (via Endpoint.AcknowledgeWake) and every repeat this Driver had already pulled into its own pending queue but not yet successfully transmitted.

requirements.title: Driver is safe for concurrent use
requirements.text: powerstate.Driver's exported methods (Pump, Acknowledge, Pending) shall be safe to call concurrently from multiple goroutines without data races or panics.

requirements.title: A stream never observed reports LivenessDead
requirements.text: deadline.Monitor.State shall report LivenessDead, and Monitor.Alive shall report false, for a stream that ObserveTrigger/ObserveHeartbeat have never been called for.

requirements.title: A trigger reports LivenessAlive, decaying to Idle then Dead as it goes stale
requirements.text: deadline.Monitor.State shall report LivenessAlive immediately after ObserveTrigger for a stream, shall report LivenessIdle once the configured Deadline has elapsed since that trigger while a more recent heartbeat is still within Deadline, and shall report LivenessDead once Deadline has elapsed since the most recent signal of any kind.

requirements.title: A heartbeat alone never produces LivenessAlive
requirements.text: deadline.Monitor.State shall report at most LivenessIdle for a stream whose only observed signals are ObserveHeartbeat calls, never LivenessAlive, regardless of how many heartbeats have been observed.

requirements.title: Config.Validate rejects a non-positive Deadline
requirements.text: deadline.Config.Validate, and by extension NewMonitor/NewMonitorWithClock, shall return ErrInvalidDeadline for a Config whose Deadline is zero or negative, and nil for a Config whose Deadline is positive.

requirements.title: DeadlineForQueue derives a Deadline from a QueueConfig's heartbeat cadence
requirements.text: deadline.DeadlineForQueue shall return q.HeartbeatIntervalMillis multiplied by missedHeartbeats (as a time.Duration in milliseconds) for a positive missedHeartbeats and nonzero q.HeartbeatIntervalMillis, ErrNoHeartbeatConfigured when q.HeartbeatIntervalMillis is zero, and ErrInvalidMissedHeartbeats when missedHeartbeats is less than 1.

requirements.title: Forget discards a stream's recorded liveness state
requirements.text: deadline.Monitor.Forget shall discard the given stream's recorded bookkeeping, after which Monitor.State reports LivenessDead for that stream exactly as if it had never been observed at all.

requirements.title: Push rejects a Kind that is not request.KindPlain or Kind.Valid
requirements.text: prioqueue.Queue.Push shall return ErrInvalidKind, and shall not enqueue an Item, when its kind argument is neither request.KindPlain nor a Kind for which Kind.Valid reports true.

requirements.title: Pop always releases the lowest-Priority pending Item first
requirements.text: prioqueue.Queue.Pop shall return the pending Item whose Kind has the numerically lowest request.Kind.Priority() value among everything currently queued, matching the specification's fixed cross-type execution-priority ordering (cancellation, chained, triggered, timed, compound-wait, compound, plain).

requirements.title: Items at equal priority are released FIFO by insertion order
requirements.text: prioqueue.Queue.Pop shall, for two or more pending Items whose Kind.Priority() values are equal, release them in the order they were enqueued via Push.

requirements.title: A safety-request Kind variant ranks identically to its Base kind
requirements.text: prioqueue.Queue shall order an Item whose Kind is a safety-request ('MSB-set') variant identically to an otherwise-equal Item whose Kind is that variant's Base kind, including FIFO interleaving between the two when both are pending at once.

requirements.title: PopAll drains every pending Item in the same order Pop would
requirements.text: prioqueue.Queue.PopAll shall return every currently-queued Item in the exact order repeated Pop calls would have returned them, leaving the queue empty (Len() == 0) afterward, and shall return nil (not an empty non-nil slice) when the queue was already empty.

requirements.title: Queue is safe for concurrent use
requirements.text: prioqueue.Queue's exported methods (Push, Pop, PopAll, Len) shall be safe to call concurrently from multiple goroutines without data races, panics, or lost/duplicated Items.

requirements.title: Controller.Discover round-trips an encoded register map
requirements.text: udp.Controller.Discover shall issue an untimed EP0 read against a udp.Server and return the responder's encoded register map, decodable by regmap.DecodeRegisterMap without loss.

requirements.title: Router.Route delivers a request to its registered Handler with the correct requester
requirements.text: udp.Router.Route shall dispatch a non-EP0 request to the request.Handler registered for its ByteBusID, passing the AVTPDU header's StreamID as the requester argument unchanged.

requirements.title: Request/response body bytes survive the AVTPDU/ACF encode/decode round trip
requirements.text: A request or response body passed through udp.Controller/udp.Server shall be reproduced byte-for-byte on the receiving side after avtp/acf encoding and decoding.

requirements.title: Router.Route reports a wire-level error response for an unregistered ByteBusID
requirements.text: udp.Router.Route shall answer a request addressed to a ByteBusID with no registered Handler with a response carrying acf.FlagError set (ErrUnknownEndpoint), not a dropped/lost request.

requirements.title: Controller.Request returns ErrTimeout on context expiry
requirements.text: udp.Controller.Request shall return udp.ErrTimeout when ctx is already cancelled or expires before a matching response arrives.

requirements.title: Controller.Request returns ErrClosed after Close
requirements.text: udp.Controller.Request shall return udp.ErrClosed for any call made after Controller.Close has completed.

requirements.title: Router.Register rejects a duplicate ByteBusID registration
requirements.text: udp.Router.Register shall return udp.ErrDuplicateEndpoint when called a second time for a ByteBusID that already has a registered Handler.

requirements.title: Router.Register rejects registering a Handler at EP0
requirements.text: udp.Router.Register shall return udp.ErrReservedAddress for addr == regmap.EP0, since EP0 is always answered by the Router's own EP0Handler.

requirements.title: Router.Route drops a timed AVTPDU when the server has no time-sync support
requirements.text: udp.Router.Route shall report shouldReply == false, and shall not invoke any Handler, for a request whose avtp.Header.Disposition resolves to avtp.DispositionDrop given the Router's configured time-sync capability.

requirements.title: Router.Route still dispatches a timed AVTPDU when the server has time-sync support
requirements.text: udp.Router.Route shall dispatch (immediately, per this milestone's documented non-goal) a request whose avtp.Header.Disposition resolves to avtp.DispositionScheduled given the Router's configured time-sync capability.

requirements.title: Registry.Dial resolves an address and registers a Controller under a caller-chosen key
requirements.text: udp.Registry.Dial shall resolve serverAddr, dial a Controller presenting the given avtp.StreamID, and register it under key, retrievable via Registry.Lookup(key).

requirements.title: Registry.Dial returns ErrAlreadyExists on duplicate key
requirements.text: udp.Registry.Dial (and Register) shall return udp.ErrAlreadyExists when key is already registered.

requirements.title: Registry.Lookup returns ErrNotFound for an unregistered key
requirements.text: udp.Registry.Lookup shall return udp.ErrNotFound for a key that has never been registered.

requirements.title: EP0Handler rejects a timed (TSCF) discovery read
requirements.text: udp.EP0Handler.HandleRequest shall answer an EP0 read framed in a presentation-timestamped (TSCF) AVTPDU header with a wire-level error, per server.Server.HandleDiscoveryRequest's untimed-only rule, never returning the register map for such a request.

requirements.title: mDNS Transport delivers packets reliably on loopback
requirements.text: mdns.Transport implementations shall deliver a WritePacket payload to a peer's ReadPacket call unmodified over a loopback UDP pair.

requirements.title: Announcer.Announce emits a well-formed DNS-SD advertisement packet
requirements.text: mdns.Announcer.Announce shall emit a DNS-SD packet containing PTR, SRV, TXT, and A records advertising the RC Server's avtp.StreamID and UDP address.

requirements.title: Browser discovers an RC Server announced on the same bus
requirements.text: mdns.Browser.Query shall invoke its Handler with the avtp.StreamID and address of an RC Server whose Announcer emits an announcement on the same bus.

requirements.title: Browser reports the correct address for a discovered RC Server
requirements.text: mdns.Browser.Query's Handler callback shall report the exact "ip:port" address the corresponding Announcer was constructed with.

requirements.title: Browser stops reading when context is cancelled
requirements.text: mdns.Browser.Query shall return once its context is cancelled, without blocking indefinitely on ReadPacket.

requirements.title: Browser ignores non-response DNS packets
requirements.text: mdns.Browser.Query shall not invoke its Handler for a DNS packet that is not a response (QR bit clear), e.g. a PTR query.

requirements.title: Browser discovers multiple RC Servers from separate announcements
requirements.text: mdns.Browser.Query shall invoke its Handler once per distinct avtp.StreamID announced by separate Announcer.Announce calls on the same bus.

requirements.title: Announcer.Close is idempotent
requirements.text: mdns.Announcer.Close shall be safe to call more than once, returning nil on every call.

requirements.title: Controller.Request round-trips a request over the shared bus
requirements.text: shmem.Controller.Request shall deliver a request to the Bus's Endpoint, dispatched through the configured udp.Router, and return the Router's response to the caller.

requirements.title: Router-registered Handler is invoked for each request routed over the bus
requirements.text: A request.Handler registered on the udp.Router backing a shmem.Endpoint shall be invoked exactly once per Controller.Request call addressed to its ByteBusID.

requirements.title: Controller.Request copies the request body before delivery
requirements.text: shmem.Controller.Request shall copy its body argument before making it visible to the Bus, so a caller's later mutation of its own buffer is not observed by the Handler.

requirements.title: Controller.Request returns ErrTimeout on a cancelled context
requirements.text: shmem.Controller.Request shall return udp.ErrTimeout when ctx is already cancelled before a matching response arrives.

requirements.title: Controller.Request returns ErrClosed after Close
requirements.text: shmem.Controller.Request shall return udp.ErrClosed for any call made after Controller.Close has completed, or after the underlying Bus has been closed.

requirements.title: Controller.Request is safe under concurrent callers
requirements.text: shmem.Controller.Request shall be safe to call concurrently from multiple goroutines on the same Controller without data races, panics, or lost/misrouted responses.

requirements.title: Controller.Loan returns a zeroed buffer of the requested size
requirements.text: loan.Controller.Loan(size) shall return an *rcp.Loan whose Payload has length exactly size and is zero-filled.

requirements.title: Controller.RequestLoaned delivers the loaned payload via the inner udp.Controller
requirements.text: loan.Controller.RequestLoaned shall deliver a loaned buffer's contents to the destination Handler unmodified, via the wrapped *udp.Controller.

requirements.title: Loaned payload reaches the Handler unmodified
requirements.text: The bytes a caller writes into a Loan's Payload before calling RequestLoaned shall be exactly the bytes the destination request.Handler observes as the request body.

requirements.title: Loan.Return is safe to call and does not panic
requirements.text: Calling (*rcp.Loan).Return() on a Loan obtained from loan.Controller.Loan, including a zero-length loan, shall not panic.

requirements.title: Controller.Loan returns an error for a negative size
requirements.text: loan.Controller.Loan shall return a non-nil error, and a nil *rcp.Loan, when called with size < 0.

requirements.title: Controller.Close rejects further Loan/RequestLoaned calls
requirements.text: After loan.Controller.Close, subsequent Loan and RequestLoaned calls shall return udp.ErrClosed.

requirements.title: Default PCPMap assigns strictly descending PCP by priority rank
requirements.text: tsn.DefaultPCPMap() shall assign a strictly decreasing IEEE 802.1p PCP value from request.Kind.Priority() rank 0 (highest priority) through rank 6 (lowest, KindPlain).

requirements.title: Controller.PCPFor returns the configured PCP for a given request.Kind
requirements.text: tsn.Controller.PCPFor(k) shall return cfg.PCPMap.PCPFor(k), the PCP value configured for k's priority rank.

requirements.title: TSN Controller.Read delivers a request over UDP and returns the Handler's response
requirements.text: tsn.Controller.Read shall deliver a read request to the destination udp.Server's registered Handler and return its response body unmodified.

requirements.title: TSN Controller.Request delivers a high-priority (cancellation-ranked) request successfully
requirements.text: tsn.Controller.Request, given request.KindCancelAll, shall still deliver the request and return a successful response — applying SO_PRIORITY must never break the send path, including on platforms where it is a no-op.

requirements.title: TSN Controller.Close causes a subsequent request to return ErrClosed
requirements.text: tsn.Controller.Close shall cause any subsequent Request/Read/Write call to return udp.ErrClosed.

requirements.title: Config VLAN and CycleNs are preserved and accessible
requirements.text: tsn.Controller.Config() shall return the same VLAN and CycleNs values the Controller was constructed with, unmodified.

requirements.title: Endpoint default handler answers with FlagResponse and preserved Read/Write
requirements.text: mock.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall, with a nil EndpointFunc, answer a request with acf.FlagResponse set and the originating FlagRead/FlagWrite bit preserved.

requirements.title: Endpoint invokes a configured EndpointFunc with requester and request
requirements.text: mock.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall, with a non-nil EndpointFunc, invoke it with the caller's requester and request.Message and return its result verbatim.

requirements.title: Endpoint rejects a request addressed to a different byte_bus_id
requirements.text: mock.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall return ErrWrongEndpoint for a request whose ByteBusID does not match the Endpoint's configured address.

requirements.title: Endpoint rejects a request after Close
requirements.text: mock.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall return ErrClosed for any request received after Close has been called.

requirements.title: Endpoint Close is idempotent
requirements.text: mock.Endpoint.Close shall be safe to call more than once.

requirements.title: Endpoint Addr reports the configured address
requirements.text: mock.Endpoint.Addr shall return the byte_bus_id address passed to NewEndpoint.

requirements.title: Client Request reaches a registered Endpoint with correct requester and body
requirements.text: mock.Client.Request shall route through the configured *udp.Router to a registered request.Handler, delivering the Client's own avtp.StreamID as requester and the caller's body unchanged.

requirements.title: Client Read/Write set exactly FlagRead/FlagWrite
requirements.text: mock.Client.Read shall submit a request with exactly acf.FlagRead set and no body; mock.Client.Write shall submit a request with exactly acf.FlagWrite set and the caller's body.

requirements.title: Client Discover round-trips a decodable register map
requirements.text: mock.Client.Discover shall return a byte slice that regmap.DecodeRegisterMap decodes into a register map reflecting every endpoint declared on the underlying server.Server.

requirements.title: Client StreamID reports the configured identity
requirements.text: mock.Client.StreamID shall return the avtp.StreamID passed to NewClient.

requirements.title: Client Close is idempotent and rejects subsequent Request
requirements.text: mock.Client.Close shall be safe to call more than once, and mock.Client.Request shall return ErrClosed for any call after Close.

requirements.title: Client Request honors a pre-cancelled context without invoking the router
requirements.text: mock.Client.Request shall return an error and must not invoke the configured Router when ctx is already done at call time.

requirements.title: Client Request is safe for concurrent use
requirements.text: mock.Client.Request shall be safe for concurrent calls without data races.
