requirements.title: Client Request assigns distinct, increasing TransactionNum values
requirements.text: mock.Client.Request shall assign each successive request a distinct avtp.TransactionNum value, incrementing across calls.

requirements.title: ClientRegistry Register makes a Client retrievable by key
requirements.text: mock.ClientRegistry.Register shall make client retrievable via Lookup under the given key.

requirements.title: ClientRegistry Register rejects a duplicate key
requirements.text: mock.ClientRegistry.Register shall return ErrAlreadyExists when key is already registered.

requirements.title: ClientRegistry Deregister closes and removes a Client; repeat reports ErrNotFound
requirements.text: mock.ClientRegistry.Deregister shall close and remove the Client registered under key, and shall return ErrNotFound for a key that is not currently registered.

requirements.title: ClientRegistry Clients reports every registered entry
requirements.text: mock.ClientRegistry.Clients shall return exactly the set of Clients currently registered.

requirements.title: ClientRegistry Close closes all registered Clients, is idempotent, and rejects further use
requirements.text: mock.ClientRegistry.Close shall call Close on every registered Client, shall be safe to call more than once, and shall cause subsequent Register/Lookup calls to return ErrClosed.

requirements.title: NewFixture claims root and wires a Router the Fixture's Root Client can use
requirements.text: mock.NewFixture shall claim rootStream as the returned Fixture's Server's root client, and the Fixture's Root Client shall present that same avtp.StreamID identity.

requirements.title: Independently constructed Fixtures never share server state
requirements.text: Two mock.NewFixture calls shall each return a Fixture with its own independent *server.Server, such that a stream that is root on one Fixture's Server is rejected as non-root on another Fixture's Server.

requirements.title: Fixture Close closes its Root Client
requirements.text: mock.Fixture.Close shall close the Fixture's Root Client.

requirements.title: Pacer fires unconditionally on the first Pump call
requirements.text: sim.Pacer.Pump shall invoke its configured FireFunc on the very first call, with no grace period.

requirements.title: Pacer withholds firing until Interval elapses on its injected Clock
requirements.text: sim.Pacer.Pump shall be a no-op, reporting fired=false, until at least Interval has elapsed since the previous fire, measured against the Pacer's injected Clock.

requirements.title: Pacer propagates FireFunc's own error
requirements.text: sim.Pacer.Pump shall return exactly the error its configured FireFunc returns.

requirements.title: Pacer Reset restarts the firing cadence
requirements.text: sim.Pacer.Reset shall cause the next Pump call to fire unconditionally, even if Interval has not yet elapsed since the previous fire.

requirements.title: Pacer Pump passes its requester argument through to FireFunc
requirements.text: sim.Pacer.Pump shall invoke FireFunc with exactly the avtp.StreamID passed as Pump's own requester argument.

requirements.title: NewADCPacer and NewPWMPacer share Pacer's firing semantics
requirements.text: sim.NewADCPacer and sim.NewPWMPacer shall each return a *sim.Pacer exhibiting the same first-call-always-fires and Interval-gated firing behaviour as sim.NewPacer.

requirements.title: LatencyHandler LatencyConstant adds at least Base delay before delegating
requirements.text: sim.LatencyHandler.HandleRequest, configured with LatencyConstant, shall sleep at least Base before delegating to the wrapped request.Handler.

requirements.title: LatencyHandler LatencyJitter stays within Base plus Jitter
requirements.text: sim.LatencyHandler.HandleRequest, configured with LatencyJitter, shall add a delay of at least Base and at most Base+Jitter before delegating.

requirements.title: LatencyHandler with zero Base/Jitter adds negligible delay
requirements.text: sim.LatencyHandler.HandleRequest, configured with Base=0 and Jitter=0, shall add no observable delay before delegating.

requirements.title: LatencyHandler HandleRequest is safe for concurrent use
requirements.text: sim.LatencyHandler.HandleRequest shall be safe for concurrent calls without data races.

requirements.title: RegisterController makes a Controller reachable through its handle
requirements.text: capi.RegisterController shall return a handle through which capi.Request reaches the registered Controller's own Request method with the given addr/control/body.

requirements.title: Request reports ErrCodeInvalidHandle for an unknown handle
requirements.text: capi.Request shall return ErrCodeInvalidHandle when handle was never registered or has already been closed.

requirements.title: Request reports ErrCodeRequestFailed when the underlying Controller errors
requirements.text: capi.Request shall return ErrCodeRequestFailed when the underlying Controller.Request call returns a non-nil error.

requirements.title: Read sets exactly FlagRead with no body
requirements.text: capi.Read shall call the underlying Controller's Request with exactly acf.FlagRead set and a nil body.

requirements.title: Write sets exactly FlagWrite with the given body
requirements.text: capi.Write shall call the underlying Controller's Request with exactly acf.FlagWrite set and the caller's body.

requirements.title: Close deregisters the handle and closes the underlying Controller
requirements.text: capi.Close shall remove handle from the registry (so HandleCount decreases and a subsequent Request returns ErrCodeInvalidHandle) and shall call Close on the underlying Controller.

requirements.title: Close on an unknown handle is a safe no-op
requirements.text: capi.Close shall not panic and shall have no observable effect when called with a handle that was never registered.

requirements.title: NewController reports ErrCodeDialFailed for an unresolvable server address
requirements.text: capi.NewController shall return ErrCodeDialFailed, without panicking, when serverAddr cannot be resolved as a UDP address.

requirements.title: ParseManifest decodes YAML and JSON server/endpoint manifests
requirements.text: codegen.ParseManifest shall decode a version-1 manifest's servers and their declared endpoints from both YAML (.yaml/.yml) and JSON (.json) input.

requirements.title: ParseManifest rejects an unsupported file extension
requirements.text: codegen.ParseManifest shall return a non-nil error for any extension other than .yaml, .yml, or .json.

requirements.title: ParseManifest rejects an unsupported manifest version
requirements.text: codegen.ParseManifest shall return an error wrapping ErrInvalidVersion when the manifest's version field is not 1.

requirements.title: ParseManifest rejects a manifest missing its package field
requirements.text: codegen.ParseManifest shall return an error wrapping ErrMissingPackage when the manifest's package field is empty.

requirements.title: ParseManifest rejects an empty server or endpoint name
requirements.text: codegen.ParseManifest shall return an error wrapping ErrEmptyName when any declared server or endpoint has an empty name.

requirements.title: ParseManifest rejects byte_bus_id 0 on a declared endpoint
requirements.text: codegen.ParseManifest shall return an error wrapping ErrReservedAddr when any declared endpoint's byte_bus_id is 0 (the reserved EP0 address).

requirements.title: Generate emits one impl and one test file per declared endpoint
requirements.text: codegen.Generate shall emit exactly one impl GeneratedFile and one test-skeleton GeneratedFile for every endpoint declared across every server in the manifest, each containing gofmt-formatted Go source with a package declaration.

requirements.title: Generated impl and test files carry matching //fusa:req/test annotations
requirements.text: codegen.Generate's impl GeneratedFile shall contain a //fusa:req annotation and its corresponding test GeneratedFile shall contain a matching //fusa:test annotation, both derived from the same server/endpoint name pair.

requirements.title: GenerateRequirements produces six .fusa-reqs.json entries per declared endpoint
requirements.text: codegen.GenerateRequirements shall produce exactly six requirement entries, each with a non-empty asil field, for every endpoint declared across every server in the manifest.

requirements.title: Recorder ring-buffer mode keeps the most recent MaxEntries while Written counts every append
requirements.text: record.Recorder, constructed with MaxEntries>0, shall retain only the MaxEntries most recently appended entries in Snapshot while Written continues to report the total number of entries ever appended, including overwritten ones.

requirements.title: Recorder unlimited mode retains every appended entry
requirements.text: record.Recorder, constructed with MaxEntries=0, shall retain every entry ever appended in Snapshot.

requirements.title: Handler records a successful call's request and response
requirements.text: record.Handler.HandleRequest, when the wrapped request.Handler succeeds, shall append an Entry to its Recorder carrying the request and response bodies with Err empty, and shall return the response unchanged.

requirements.title: Handler records a failing call's error text
requirements.text: record.Handler.HandleRequest, when the wrapped request.Handler errors, shall append an Entry to its Recorder carrying Err set to the error's message text, and shall return the error unchanged.

requirements.title: WriteTo/ReadFrom round-trip Recorder entries intact
requirements.text: record.Recorder.WriteTo followed by record.ReadFrom shall reproduce every entry's Requester, Request, and Response fields unchanged.

requirements.title: ReadFrom detects a corrupted log with ErrCorrupted
requirements.text: record.ReadFrom shall return an error wrapping ErrCorrupted when a logged entry's payload does not match its trailing CRC32.

requirements.title: Replay feeds recorded requests into a target Handler in order
requirements.text: record.Replay shall call target.HandleRequest once per recorded request, in the same order as Snapshot, and shall return the responses received.

requirements.title: Handler HandleRequest is safe for concurrent use
requirements.text: record.Handler.HandleRequest shall be safe for concurrent calls without data races.

requirements.title: Controller StreamID delegates to the inner Controller
requirements.text: observe's wrapped Controller StreamID method shall return exactly the inner Controller's own StreamID.

requirements.title: Controller Request delegates to the inner Controller and returns its response
requirements.text: observe's wrapped Controller Request method shall call the inner Controller's Request with the given addr/control/body and return its response unchanged on success.

requirements.title: A successful Request records latency and sets health true for a non-error response
requirements.text: observe's wrapped Controller Request method shall, on success, call Metrics.ObserveRequestLatency once and call Metrics.SetEndpointHealth with healthy=true when the response carries no acf.FlagError.

requirements.title: A successful Request with a FlagError response sets health false
requirements.text: observe's wrapped Controller Request method shall call Metrics.SetEndpointHealth with healthy=false when a successful Request's response carries acf.FlagError.

requirements.title: A failing Request increments the error counter without recording latency or health
requirements.text: observe's wrapped Controller Request method shall, when the inner Controller.Request errors, call Metrics.IncRequestError and shall not call ObserveRequestLatency or SetEndpointHealth.

requirements.title: A timeout-shaped error also increments the deadline-miss counter
requirements.text: observe's wrapped Controller Request method shall call Metrics.IncDeadlineMiss when the inner Controller.Request's error wraps udp.ErrTimeout or context.DeadlineExceeded.

requirements.title: Controller Close is idempotent and closes the inner Controller
requirements.text: observe's wrapped Controller Close method shall be safe to call more than once and shall call Close on the inner Controller.

requirements.title: Controller Request is safe for concurrent use
requirements.text: observe's wrapped Controller Request method shall be safe for concurrent calls without data races.

requirements.title: Handler with no rules delegates directly to the wrapped Handler
requirements.text: faultinject.Handler.HandleRequest shall delegate directly to the wrapped request.Handler when no Rule is currently active.

requirements.title: FaultDrop returns an error without reaching the wrapped Handler
requirements.text: faultinject.Handler.HandleRequest, with an active FaultDrop rule, shall return a non-nil error and must not call the wrapped request.Handler.

requirements.title: FaultSlow sleeps at least Latency then forwards to the wrapped Handler
requirements.text: faultinject.Handler.HandleRequest, with an active FaultSlow rule, shall sleep at least Rule.Latency, then call the wrapped request.Handler.

requirements.title: FaultCRCFailure returns e2e.ErrCRCMismatch without reaching the wrapped Handler
requirements.text: faultinject.Handler.HandleRequest, with an active FaultCRCFailure rule, shall return an error wrapping e2e.ErrCRCMismatch and must not call the wrapped request.Handler.

requirements.title: FaultSafeStateEntry returns request.ErrPurgedByWatchdog
requirements.text: faultinject.Handler.HandleRequest, with an active FaultSafeStateEntry rule, shall return an error wrapping request.ErrPurgedByWatchdog.

requirements.title: FaultDiscoveryClaimTimeout returns discovery.ErrNotConfigurationClaimant
requirements.text: faultinject.Handler.HandleRequest, with an active FaultDiscoveryClaimTimeout rule, shall return an error wrapping discovery.ErrNotConfigurationClaimant.

requirements.title: FaultCancellation returns request.ErrTicketCancelled
requirements.text: faultinject.Handler.HandleRequest, with an active FaultCancellation rule, shall return an error wrapping request.ErrTicketCancelled.

requirements.title: A Count-based rule fires exactly Count times then auto-expires
requirements.text: faultinject.Handler, given a Rule with Count>0, shall apply that rule on exactly the next Count matching calls, then fall through to the wrapped Handler on subsequent calls; ClearRules shall remove every active rule immediately.

requirements.title: Handler HandleRequest and AddRule are safe for concurrent use
requirements.text: faultinject.Handler.HandleRequest and AddRule shall be safe for concurrent calls without data races.

requirements.title: Update rejects an empty image
requirements.text: firmware.Updater.Update shall return ErrImageEmpty for a zero-length image.

requirements.title: Update rejects an image larger than MaxImageSize
requirements.text: firmware.Updater.Update shall return ErrImageTooLarge for an image longer than MaxImageSize.

requirements.title: Update delivers chunks with consistent CRC32 and advancing offsets
requirements.text: firmware.Updater.Update shall deliver every chunk via its configured TransportFunc carrying the whole image's CRC-32 in every chunk's ChunkPayload.CRC32, with ChunkPayload.Offset advancing by ChunkSize per chunk.

requirements.title: A FlagError chunk response aborts delivery with ErrEndpointRejected
requirements.text: firmware.Updater.Update shall stop sending further chunks and return an error wrapping ErrEndpointRejected as soon as a chunk delivery's response carries acf.FlagError.

requirements.title: A FlagError verify response reports ErrCRCMismatch
requirements.text: firmware.Updater.Update shall return ErrCRCMismatch when the post-install verify call's response carries acf.FlagError.

requirements.title: A fully-acknowledged Update reports no error
requirements.text: firmware.Updater.Update shall return nil when every chunk delivery and the verify call succeed without acf.FlagError.

requirements.title: Concurrent Update calls on one Updater are serialized with ErrUpdateInProgress
requirements.text: firmware.Updater.Update shall return ErrUpdateInProgress immediately for a call that arrives while another Update on the same Updater is still in progress.

requirements.title: ChunkPayload Marshal/UnmarshalChunkPayload round-trips every field
requirements.text: firmware.UnmarshalChunkPayload applied to firmware.ChunkPayload.Marshal's output shall reproduce TotalSize, Offset, CRC32, and Data unchanged.
